# Wasteland medicine: core mixtures
Amounts are in reagent units (u), not whole plants. Use the exact extracts listed. Heat only recipes with a temperature requirement.
## Antiseptic
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u Abraxo Cleaner + 1u ethanol
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u Antiseptic.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] A preparation ingredient for other medicines; it is not a substitute for a healing chem. ## Handmade antidote
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u tarberry juice + 1u scorpion tail
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u handmade antidote.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals poison damage; Can cause vomiting. ## Refined antidote
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u handmade antidote + 1u ethanol
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 354 K (80.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u refined antidote.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals poison, radiation damage. ## Radaway
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u irradiated fungus extract + 2u Antiseptic + 2u water
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u radaway.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals radiation damage; Reduces feralization progression. ## Diluted radaway
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u radaway + 2u water
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u diluted radaway.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals radiation damage; Reduces feralization progression. ## Stimpak
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u broc flower extract + 1u xander extract + 1u blood
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u stimpak.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals burn, brute, airloss damage; Reduces bleeding; At 30u or more: Can cause vomiting. ## Dirty stimpak
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u broc flower extract + 1u xander extract + 1u waster blood
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u dirty stimpak.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Applies recovery status; Heals burn, brute, airloss damage; Causes radiation, poison damage; Reduces bleeding; At 30u or more: Heals burn, brute, airloss damage; At 30u or more: Causes poison damage; At 50u or more: Causes poison damage. ## Bitterdrink
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u brahmin milk + 1u glowpepper juice + 1u pinyon juice
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 354 K (80.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 4u bitterdrink.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals radiation, poison damage; At 25u or more: Can cause vomiting; Reduces feralization progression. ## Epoetine
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u oxygen + 1u uranium (catalyst; retained)
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u epoetine.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals asphyxiation, bloodloss damage; At 20u or more: Causes asphyxiation, cold damage. ## Beta epoetine
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u epoetine + 1u carbon + 1u iron
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u beta epoetine.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals asphyxiation, bloodloss damage; Removes heartbreaker toxin in the body; At 25u or more: Causes asphyxiation, cold damage.
